headline: Turkey's Ziraat Bank Outlines $2 Billion in COP31 Financing Deals
summary: State-owned Ziraat Bank signed agreements and outlined planned transactions totaling approximately $2 billion tied to the COP31 climate summit, supporting renewable energy, sustainable agriculture, and rural development.
why: Ziraat Bank is Turkey's largest bank by total assets and the premier lender to the agricultural and rural commercial sectors.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Mobilizing $2 billion in dedicated green transition financing accelerates renewable and agricultural investments.
